user.title: Crypto Trend
user.description: Prices and trends of cryptocurrencies from CoinGecko. Add one entry per currency. No key is needed; a free CoinGecko Demo key raises the rate limit.

data_description.currency: Currency prices are shown in (eur, usd, ...).
data_description.api_key: Optional. Leave empty to use the public API.

coins.title: Coins
coins.description: Pick the coins to follow, or type their CoinGecko ID (e.g. `bitcoin`) or ticker (e.g. `btc`).

data_description.coins: The 100 largest coins are listed; any other can be typed in.

reauth_confirm.title: CoinGecko key rejected
reauth_confirm.description: CoinGecko no longer accepts the configured API key. Enter a new Demo key, or leave empty for the public API.

error.invalid_api_key: CoinGecko rejected this API key (only Demo keys are supported).
error.cannot_connect: Could not reach CoinGecko, or the currency is not supported.
